newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to trade modestly, capped at 4,870.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to trade modestly, capped at 4,870.

text.p: The chances of the FTSE 100 index making a rapid rise on Tuesday are slim, and the index is likely to show modest movement with an upper limit around 4,870, technical analysts said.
Changes in leadership by stocks within the index will make any dash towards record highs difficult to accomplish near-term, they added.
Banking stocks may revive, having been left behind by utilities and chemicals stocks recently, but overall market activity will be cautious despite positive market breadth.
By 0746 GMT, the FTSE was up 6.0 at 4,863.4.
